name: OmniRun

modes.label: Launch plan sandbox-hours
modes.note: EUR 0.19/sandbox-hour overage on Launch x 1.1378 USD/EUR (ECB 2026-09-28). "One sandbox-hour is one hour of a standard sandbox (up to 4 vCPU, 2 GB RAM). Larger configurations consume proportionally more. Billed per-second." The scaling rule for larger shapes is not published, so only the standard size is encoded (bigger workloads show as capped at 4 vCPU / 2 GB).

modes.label: Scale plan sandbox-hours

Larger configurations consume proportionally more. Billed per-second." The scaling rule for larger shapes is not published, so only the standard size is encoded (bigger workloads show as capped at 4 vCPU / 2 GB).

plans.name: Sandbox
plans.note: EUR 0/mo, 25 sandbox-hours, 1 concurrent sandbox (4 vCPU / 2 GB): a trial allowance, not a paid tier (no overage rate published).

plans.name: Launch (EUR 19 monthly / EUR180 annual)
plans.note: EUR 19/mo includes 100 sandbox-hours (= 100 x EUR 0.19 overage, so the fee works as usage credit); 3 concurrent; 4 vCPU / 4 GB max. Annual EUR 15/mo not modelled.

plans.name: Scale (EUR79 monthly / EUR756 annual)
plans.note: EUR 79/mo includes 600 sandbox-hours (= EUR 90 at the EUR 0.15 overage): fee as credit plus EUR 11 extra included; 10 concurrent; 8 vCPU / 16 GB max. Annual EUR 63/mo not modelled.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Unknown limits are not promises of unlimited capacity.

caveats: Priced (fix 2026-09-28) from omnirun.io/pricing in EUR x 1.1378 USD/EUR: Launch EUR 0.19, Scale EUR 0.15 per standard sandbox-hour (up to 4 vCPU / 2 GB). Only 2 GB RAM per standard sandbox-hour; larger RAM "consumes proportionally more" without a published formula, so a 4/8 workload is shown capped at 4 vCPU / 2 GB. Dedicated (EUR 0.10/h, custom fee, 50+ concurrent) not priced.

Public prices in EUR; USD unknown. Base sandbox-hour means up to 4 vCPU/2 GB; larger shapes consume proportionally more but exact scaling rule is not defined. Do not infer price for 4/8 by multiplying without a published formula.

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.

fleet.notes: 10 fits Scale; 50 Dedicated, 300/1,000 need custom confirmation. Free queues beyond cap. Support response times (24h/4h) are not quota approval times.
